reason: I don't buy things from an ad or an app I've never heard of. My daughter does the Instagram and that's enough for now; if another café owner I know used this and told me it works, maybe, but not from a stranger.
objection: The AI puts a wrong price on my site and customers come in arguing that the cappuccino is cheaper than what I charge. And who do I call when it goes wrong, a WhatsApp bot?
would_change_my_mind: Another café owner in Sofia I know shows me it on their phone, tells me it never got a price wrong, and there's a real person who speaks Bulgarian I can call.
